entries.0affdf18234e4fc8: The company consists of the company and 37 subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026). Founded in 1938 in Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo, as Otsuka Seisakusho, the company has its head office in Toyohashi, Aichi Prefecture. Consolidated employees number 12,227 (fiscal year ended March 2026).
entries.0f78794336678fa1: The company manufactures and sells powertrain components (such as gears and camshafts), suspension and steering components, and two-wheeler components. It also handles new products such as hybrid supercapacitors and AI visual inspection machines.
entries.22246bcbb0093dc4: Manufacturing and sales in the regions covered by the company and its domestic subsidiaries. Parts are produced at the head office and factory complex in Toyohashi, Aichi Prefecture, as well as by Kyushu Musashi Seimitsu Co., Ltd. and Musashi Casting Co., Ltd. The subsidiary Musashi Energy Solutions Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures and sells hybrid supercapacitors. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥41,541 million.
entries.3318456c90deed59: Manufacturing and sales in the regions covered by subsidiaries in Germany, Hungary and Spain. Products of the Powertrain (PT) Business and the Linkage & Suspension (L&S) Business are produced. In light of the severe market environment, structural reforms centered on optimizing production capacity and reorganizing sites have been decided. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥84,920 million.
entries.41b76a286c29dbe8: Manufacturing and sales in the regions covered by subsidiaries in Thailand, Indonesia, India and Vietnam. In addition to products of the Powertrain (PT) Business and the Linkage & Suspension (L&S) Business, two-wheeler business products are also produced, and sales of two-wheeler vehicles in India have grown significantly. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥80,657 million.

entries.71090168dcadedca: The company states that its flagship product, differentials, holds the world's top share, and that its two-wheeler transmission assemblies also hold the world's top share. Orders for components used in BEVs and HEVs have remained firm, and the number of models in India equipped with the company's e-Axle (EV drive unit) is expanding.

Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥111,006 million, the largest among the five reportable segments.

entries.f8bdd009ecadc868: It has set a long-term vision, “MUSASHI 100-Year Vision Go Far Beyond! ~Break the Frame and Set Out on an Adventure!~”, and sets policies from three perspectives: people, systems and business. In business, it aims for further growth through deepening its Mobility Business and creating new businesses, and says it is also advancing business transformation through the use of AI and digital technologies.
